descriptionChirho: Battle, war, armed conflict -- an Aramaic loanword (cf. Syriac qrav) used in poetic and late biblical texts. Occurs in absolute and prepositional forms: as subject/object denoting combat (Job 38:23; Ps 78:9; Eccl 9:18; Zech 14:3), in the plural for repeated battles (Ps 68:30), with le- preposition expressing purpose 'for battle' (Ps 144:1), with min- preposition 'from battle' (Ps 55:18), with we- conjunction 'and war' (Ps 55:21), and with ba- preposition 'in the battle' (2 Sam 17:11). Glossed uniformly as 'battle/war' (eng), 'القتال/حرب' (arb), '전투/전쟁' (kor), 'batalla/guerra' (spa), 'युद्ध' (hin).
